name: Conversationmaxxing

lead: Conversationmaxxing is the looksmaxxing-community term for treating conversation as a trainable skill. The idea is that how someone talks, listens and keeps an exchange going shapes how attractive they seem in person, so improving it adds to the overall impression alongside face, body and style.

It works through the social side of attraction: a person who is easy to talk to, who lets pauses breathe and finds shared topics, can come across as more appealing than their photos suggest. The term is discussed mostly in dating contexts on forums; no published trial has tested a program under this name.

paras: Forum users describe it in everyday terms: talking at a relaxed pace, letting conversation unfold rather than rushing, finding common interests (one user mentions anime and manga with a date, another astrology), and asking how to keep a conversation going after the first few dates. It is practised through ordinary social contact rather than products or procedures.

There are no physical risks. Forum threads note that some users find talking with the people they are interested in difficult or dull, and the approach depends on the other person's interests; no outcomes are guaranteed.

chain: More rapport and a more attractive impression in person
angle.text: Community members present conversation skill as a way to be perceived as more attractive that does not depend on facial features. The practice is free and happens through everyday conversations.

lead: Conversationmaxxing is a looksmaxxing-community term for deliberately improving one's conversational skill as a way of becoming more attractive and likeable in person. It belongs to the lifestyle side of the community, where charm, humour and social ease are treated as traits that can be developed in the same spirit as grooming or fitness.

People use it mainly in dating and first-impression settings. The goal is that a pleasant, well-paced conversation raises how appealing someone is regardless of their facial structure, so the skill is framed as looks-independent. A looksmax.org thread titled around the term asks how to keep a conversation alive after the first few dates, with the original poster describing a preference for talking slowly and letting a conversation breathe [1].
The practice has no formal definition, founder or published research under this name. It is documented here as it appears in forum discussion.

paras: The term combines conversation with the community suffix "-maxxing", meaning to optimise one aspect of oneself. In practice it covers pacing, choice of topics, curiosity about the other person and the ability to keep a conversation going over several meetings [1].

A thread on looksmax.org uses the term for a question about sustaining conversation with a date after the first few meetings. The original poster describes a slow, unhurried style and mentions finding conversation with women less engaging than with men; replies suggest topics such as shared hobbies and gossip, and one participant says they talk with a date about anime and manga and astrology-related interests [1].

lore.intro: On looksmax.org the term appears in dating-advice style threads where members compare how they keep conversations going [1].

claims.claim: Better conversation skill can add to attractiveness independent of looks
